# AI Visual Prompt Cookbook

> 154 plug-and-play visual style packs for AI image generation (Nano Banana Pro, GPT Image, Midjourney, ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude).
> Each style is one structured style.json: paste it into an LLM image workflow, replace the variables, keep the look.

Curated by Vigo Zhao (https://x.com/VigoCreativeAI). Source: https://github.com/VigoZhao/AI-Visual-Prompt-Cookbook

## How to use a style

1. Pick a style below and open its page, or fetch its raw style.json.
2. Paste the whole JSON into the chat or image workflow.
3. Replace the values in `environment_variables` (subject, headline text, aspect ratio...) and generate.

- [Online gallery](https://prompts.vigocreativeai.com/site/): searchable previews of every style
- [Catalog](https://github.com/VigoZhao/AI-Visual-Prompt-Cookbook/blob/main/docs/CATALOG.md): full list with categories
